name: firstch-tools
description: 42 local MCP tools for web production and development work, from the free browser tools at tools.first-ch.com: WCAG contrast checks, Japanese character / X-weight counting, WebP conversion, JSON-LD, llms.txt and robots.txt generation, Marp slides, encoding and format conversion (JSON/YAML/CSV/Markdown tables), and everyday developer utilities. They run on your machine via npx and send nothing. Plus 33 app_* tools (off by default; enable with FIRSTCH_ENABLE_APPS=1) that call the web apps at apps.first-ch.com and send their input (a URL, domain or text) there; the apps store nothing.
